categories.title: Categories
categories.subtitle: Categories group your products in the store (e.g. Whole Spices, Powders).
categories.pageHelp: To take a category out of the store, hide it — deleting one can orphan the products inside it. A product can also sit on more than one shelf: set its extra categories from the product form rather than duplicating it here.

categories.hiddenBody: "{{name}}" is no longer shown in the store.

sections.title: Homepage Sections
sections.subtitle: Sections are the product rows on your store's homepage (e.g. Best Sellers).
sections.pageHelp: Order matters — whatever you put first is what customers see first, and only as many products as the row's limit are shown. After a festival, hide the section instead of emptying it, so you can bring the same row back next year.
sections.empty: No sections yet. Click "Add Section" to create your first homepage row.
sections.dialogDescription: A section is a row of products on the homepage.
sections.arrangeDescription: Use the arrows to change the order customers see. The top product shows first.

bulkEdit.title: Bulk Price & Stock
bulkEdit.subtitle: Change many prices or stock levels at once. Edit the boxes, then review and save.
bulkEdit.pageHelp: The fastest way to correct stock after a counter sale, breakage or a returned parcel — the store only adjusts stock by itself for orders and cancellations. Leave a box blank to leave that value alone. Changing a price never changes a bill that has already been issued.
bulkEdit.reviewDescription_one: This will change {{count}} product. Check the list, then save.
bulkEdit.reviewDescription_other: This will change {{count}} products. Check the list, then save.
